checkpoint.title: ImGui IO ownership and engine input reroute

goal: Move native IO hook ownership to ImGuiIntegration and route editor/play input through one ImGuiIOInput snapshot.
fixed_decisions: Input is sourced from ImGuiIOInput after ImGui consumes native events.
Official imgui_impl_glfw remains the platform backend.
No compatibility path keeps GLFW callback-side input writes alive.

tasks.title: Centralize official ImGui GLFW backend ownership
work: Make ImGuiIntegration the only code path that initializes, ticks, and shuts down imgui_impl_glfw.
Keep callback installation delegated to official imgui_impl_glfw.
Remove or stop using WindowContext callback registration APIs when their only remaining purpose is legacy input fanout.
must_be_true: No non-ImGuiIntegration code calls imgui_impl_glfw APIs.
WindowSystem still owns native window lifetime and PollEvents.
No custom ImGui platform backend is introduced.

tasks.title: Delete GLFW callback-side engine input writes
work: Remove key, mouse, cursor, scroll, and camera state writes from GLFW callbacks.
Keep only native window lifecycle and surface-related behavior in the window implementation.
Keep cursor mode writes as WindowSystem commands driven by editor/play policy, not by raw callbacks.
must_be_true: No GLFW callback writes WindowInput camera movement.
No GLFW callback writes WindowInput mouse button, key button, or scroll state.
No compatibility callback path remains for the old input model.

tasks.title: Introduce concrete ImGuiIOInput snapshot
work: Define fields for key state, mouse button state, cursor position, mouse delta, wheel, capture flags, F5/F8 input, and cursor visibility intent.
Build the snapshot after WindowSystem::PollEvents and ImGuiIntegration::BeginFrame.
Use ImGuiIO capture flags to block editor camera input unless play-mode policy explicitly overrides capture.
must_be_true: There is exactly one input snapshot consumed by editor/play policy per frame.
The snapshot is concrete and local; it is not a generic pass-through wrapper.
WindowInput is only a temporary engine-facing sink.

tasks.title: Move editor and play input policy to snapshot consumption
work: Move camera focus, Scene Color hover activity, F5 play, F8 possess/eject, and cursor hide/show policy to consume ImGuiIOInput.
Keep play-mode override on top of ImGuiIOInput instead of a raw input side path.
Preserve current camera-facing WindowInput fields until a separate input-system refactor exists.
must_be_true: Editor camera input is not updated before ImGui consumes native events.
UI text input and camera input do not both consume the same captured event in editor mode.
Play mode has explicit override semantics and does not depend on GLFW callback ordering.

exit_gate: ImGuiIntegration is the only native IO hook owner.
ImGuiIOInput is the only source for editor camera/play input.
GLFW callback-side WindowInput writes are deleted.
Official imgui_impl_glfw remains the platform backend.
just r starts and input smoke coverage passes.
validation: Run just r after a successful build.
Manual runtime coverage: editor camera movement, UI text input, F5 play, F8 possess/eject, cursor hide/show, Scene Color hover focus, and shutdown.

summary: Window-system GLFW callbacks no longer write WindowInput.
ImGuiIOInput captures mouse, keyboard, wheel, capture flags, and play-mode hotkeys after ImGui NewFrame.
Editor and console input policy now consumes ImGui state instead of raw WindowInput callback state.
